purpose: Define a threshold-free technical feature engine that uses only signal-date-or-earlier bars and prefers price-scale-invariant transforms.

invariance.caveat: Scale invariance removes uniform retrospective normalization drift but does not prove immunity to corrected historical OHLC values or non-uniform vendor revisions.

leakage_controls: all rolling operations are backward-looking and include at most the current D row
no negative shift is permitted in the feature engine
outcome/forward-return columns are not accepted as feature inputs
cross-sectional rank, when used, is computed within the same bar_date only
future rows may be appended or altered without changing any feature at an earlier D
promotion_policy: Feature calculations may support retrospective research only; they do not emit Setup/Episode.
